props.label: About Me
props.heading: I set the whole thing up for you
props.body:
I work with Tapify, helping shops, clinics, salons and service businesses get online properly — not just a page that exists, but one that brings enquiries in.

Most people I meet already have a website they paid for once and never touched again, or a stack of visiting cards in a drawer. The problem is rarely the design. It is that nothing sends work back to them.

What I do is set the whole thing up: the digital card, the website, the QR code on the counter, the review link that goes out after a job, the WhatsApp replies that answer at nine at night. Then I show you how to change it yourself, because you should not have to call me to update your own prices.

If you want to see what that looks like for your business, message me and I will walk you through it — no charge for the conversation.

notes:
INTERNAL TEMPLATE. One site per Tapify sales representative — a personal landing page they can hand to a prospect so the prospect contacts THEM rather than head office. Four pages: Home (/), Products (/products), Services (/services), Contact (/contact). Home carries all nine requested sections in the requested order.

TOKENS: {{REP_NAME}} and {{REP_EMAIL}} are substituted per representative when the site is created (see run-sales-portfolios.php). If you create a site from this recipe through the builder UI instead, those tokens appear literally and must be edited by hand — that is deliberate, they read as obvious placeholders rather than someone else's name.

THEME: copper-ridge, the same preset the architecture recipe uses — bronze #8B6914 with a warm sand background, Poppins headings and Inter body. Requested specifically. No new theme was created.

NO PHOTOGRAPH OF A PERSON ANYWHERE. These are real named people's pages, so putting a stock model's face on them would be a lie the moment a prospect met them. Hero and about use product and handshake imagery with no identifiable face. Each rep should add their own photograph to the about section.

NO PHONE OR WHATSAPP: showPhone, showWhatsapp and showAddress are all FALSE on the contact section and no phone is set in business, because no numbers were supplied. The enquiry form and the rep's own email are the working channels. Turn the phone fields on in the builder once each rep's number is added to Business Info — the section picks it up automatically.

TESTIMONIALS ARE DELIBERATELY MARKED AS PLACEHOLDERS, in the heading itself, not just in a note. Fabricating customer quotes for a real named salesperson is not the same as seeding a demo template, and these sites go live under real people's names. Either replace them with genuine feedback or delete the section before the page is shared.

IMAGES: hosted Pexels CDN URLs, every one fetched and visually checked. Replace the gallery with photographs of real local customers as soon as there are any — that is the single highest-value edit on this page.

PRICING is deliberately absent. The copy says 'message me for pricing' throughout, so reps are not bound to a number on a public page and can quote per deal.
